guidance.sentence: We’ve strengthened our competitive position and are on track to deliver $900 million in cost-reduction synergies in 2026 resulting in stronger organic revenue growth, operating margins, and earnings per share,” said John Wren, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Omnicom.

summary: Omnicom says it is on track to deliver $900 million in cost-reduction synergies from the Interpublic acquisition in 2026, which it expects to support stronger organic revenue growth, operating margins and earnings per share.
